anyOf.description: Network egress restricted to an allowlist of destination hosts.

Capability.description: A capability grant in a `libraries:` entry (RFC 005 capability model).

GitImport.description: `import: { git, ref, file }` — fetch `file` from `git` at `ref`.

file.description: Path of the YAML document inside the repository.

ref.description: Tag, branch, or commit SHA. Tags/SHAs cache forever; branches revalidate against the remote after a short TTL.

anyOf.description: A relative filesystem path, or an `http(s)://` URL with the ref already pinned in the path.
A file at a ref of an arbitrary git remote (SSH or HTTPS).

ImportSpec.description: The value of a top-level `import:` key.

LibraryRef.description: One `libraries:` entry — a value-generator library bound to a token alias.

as.description: Token alias — `${alias.fn(...)}`. Default: the library's name part (`random` for `@std/random@v1`). Must be a lowercase identifier and unique across all declared libraries.

capabilities.description: Explicit capability grants, fail-closed: any non-empty grant requires `allow_library_capabilities: true` in the config. `fs` / `clock` are bare strings; network egress is an object with a host allowlist (`net: ["api.example.com"]`) — raw sockets are never granted.

use.description: Library reference: `@std/random@v1` (built-in, native). Local paths, HTTPS URLs and git refs are WASM libraries — accepted syntactically but rejected at validation until phase 2 lands the WASM runtime.

with.description: JSON config handed to the library at instantiation (`with:`). May use `${{ env.X }}` like any other parameter block.

Step.description: A single step in a test definition.

check.description: Post-execution assertions.  Keys are assertion names; values are expected values.  Example: `{ "status": 200, "duration_ms_lt": 500 }`.

message.description: Custom message for `std/thresholds@v1` steps (interpolated, appended to the auto-generated violation summary). Meaningless for other actions.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in log output.

outputs.description: Variable name to store step output under for `${{ name.field }}` use.

severity.description: Gate severity for `std/thresholds@v1` steps: `fail` (default), `warn`, or `info`. Meaningless for other actions.

use.description: Action identifier, e.g. `"std/http@v1"`. Written as `use:` in YAML; `uses:` is accepted as an alias (GitHub-Actions muscle memory).

uses.description: Action identifier, e.g. `"std/http@v1"`. Written as `use:` in YAML; `uses:` is accepted as an alias (GitHub-Actions muscle memory).

description: Top-level test definition — a list of steps executed per VU iteration.

import.description: Base document to inherit from — a relative path, an `http(s)://` URL, or `{ git, ref, file }`. The base loads first (recursively), then this document deep-merges on top; a local `steps:` list replaces the base's. Remote sources require the caller's `--allow-remote-import`.

libraries.description: Value-generator libraries for `${alias.fn(...)}` tokens (RFC 005). Concatenates with the config file's and with imported documents' declarations; a duplicate alias is a validation error.
